'''Komo''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was posted on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where he asked an Imperial to ruin a Republic hydroplant.<ref name="TOR" />
